t: This Soudal Repair Express is a ready-to-use solution for effective cement and concrete repair, ideal for professional tradespeople working on various construction projects. It offers fast curing properties and excellent adhesion to diverse mineral surfaces, ensuring a durable finish. This product is suitable for both interior and exterior applications, making it perfect for repairing mortar joints in brickwork or concrete structures up to 50mm deep. The 290ml cartridge is easily applied with a standard gun, and once dried, the grey filler is paintable and sandable, providing a seamless and professional repair.
b: For Repairing Masonry, Concrete or Brickwork
